act_title: The Representation of the People Act, 1951
title: Presentation of petitions
text:
81. Presentation of petitions.—(1) An election petition calling in question any election may be presented

on one or more of the grounds specified in [sub-section (1)] of section 100 and section 101 to the [High
Court] by any candidate at such election or any elector [within forty-five days from, but not earlier than the
date of election of the returned candidate, or if there are more than one returned candidate at the election and
the dates of their election are different, the later of those two dates].
